headline_options: Limited beta: duplicate checklists within a project
Project owners can try checklist duplication in selected Standard workspaces
confirmed_change: Project owners can duplicate an existing checklist within the same project.
audience_impact: The change is scoped to project owners on the Standard plan in selected workspaces.
limitation: Duplication does not copy file attachments; cross-project duplication is unavailable.

fact_trace.statement: Project owners can duplicate an existing checklist within the same project.
The beta is limited to selected workspaces and Standard-plan project owners.
Attachments are not copied and cross-project duplication is unavailable.
